purpose: One record per submitted outbound link. The intended fields and the observed fields are stored separately and are never merged, reconciled or used to fill each other in.
rule: An 'intended' value may only be written after the destination has been confirmed inside the enrolled Associates workflow. Until that happens the field stays empty.

links.observed_method: Fetched the short URL and read the resolved page title and canonical product URL.
links.note: The 9-character short code differs from the 10-character ASIN it resolves to. The code must not be recorded as the ASIN.
